subject: ours:statechart
why: Bead cr-r2pa.2.28.3, plan 83 (with its Round 2 table). New model-invocable skill: it models something that moves between states in TLA+, checks every reachable state with TLC through its own Python tool (scripts/statechart.py and statechart_lib, with tests and fixtures) and leaves a Mermaid statechart with a report giving the shortest path to each broken rule; it changes no product code. Model-invocable because the generated formal verify skill points a later agent at it for reading TLA+ results, which a manual-only skill could not serve (plan 83 §1). The install ran per user with every pinned checksum and publisher signature checked (83/install.log, 83/pins/). 78 traits: 75 adopted (the 75 pending adopts below: 47 carried by the tool, 17 written for TLA+ with TLC, 2 fixed wordings verbatim, 6 under their into IDs, 6 in references/render.md saying rendering is unproven), check-never-weakened-to-pass held, and 2 of ours: checker-install-approved-per-user (decision 6, the engine decision, owner item 2) and checker-install-signed-and-undoable (the blind check's five install rows, owner item 2, plan 83 §6). Critics 87e-87v and 90d (each REVISE, fixed in rounds) and the blind check 87.
